newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Police find suspicious BMW car that may be related to killing of Taoyuan magistrate Liu Pang-you.
Sixth-grade girl hit by car and raped.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - More than 100 taxi drivers in mass street fight over minor traffic dispute.
Police suspect BMW car may be related to Taoyuan shooting.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - European council to set up representative office in Taiwan.
Liberalisation of information technology products is main topic in WTO ministers' meeting.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - State-run Chines Petroleum Corp to hike oil prices between eight and 10 percent.
Taiwan's export remittances hit record high US$11.4 million in November.
LIBERTY TIMES _ Oil prices hikes to be announced this week.
Democratic Progressive Party to hold series of events to commemorate member Peng Wan-ju, who was stabbed 35 times in fatal attack.
